title: StratumTracker trusts a raw caller-supplied epoch floor per adoption
description: Correctness/security review: authoritative adoption accepts a scalar epoch_floor from every caller instead of binding firmware build and verified provision state. Passing zero can admit time below the real build floor. Bind a floor authority/result derived from immutable build epoch plus ProvisionVerifier, refresh only through an authenticated/admin transition, and keep raw scalar helpers non-authoritative.
